headline: Signals contract in, the 51 static pages now record visits and source opens, and abstract reasoning completes the reasoning pair in CS/SK/EN with options that can't be gamed.

shipped.title: Signals contract and bot filter; page_view and source_open on the static pages
shipped.live_checked: Live /ai-act/article-99/ carries the beacon and data-doc/data-ref links. Real Chromium (Supabase routed, no rows written): a person sends page_view {path, static} then key_action source_open; webdriver sends nothing. Deploy tagged deploy-2026-10-28. The shared insert policy accepts both event names (read from pg_policies).

shipped.title: Abstract reasoning in Czech, Slovak or English: 10 series, 10 minutes
shipped.live_checked: Deploy tagged deploy-2026-10-28-2. Live at 390 px: Practice -> Abstract reasoning -> Slovenčina -> Začať shows 'Otázka 1 z 10', 5 series figures and 4 option figures; a full sitting scores (2 z 10) with 10 explained solutions.

signals_fixed: Signals contract test and vendored allow-list (v2, 2026-10-27): src/platform/flywheel-events.contract.test.ts + flywheel-events.json. No pending names used.
flywheel-client: isAutomatedBrowser; webdriver, bot, headless and audit UAs send nothing.

Analytics bundle guard on the uploaded dist (# flywheel:analytics-guard). Local fix: the kit's includes('.supabase.co') always passed because supabase-js carries '*.supabase.co'; it now requires https://<ref>.supabase.co. Flywheel should take the same fix into the kit.
deploy.yml: concurrency ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress only off main.
Static pages: page_view {path, static: true} and key_action source_open {doc, ref, from: 'static'} from a ~1 KB inline beacon, same row, ids and bot rule as the client.
App: key_action source_open from the answer note (from: 'answer') and the commonplace book (from: 'commonplace'). New key_action actions: abstract_start, abstract_finish.

mechanics.name: Likely score on a fresh paper
mechanics.from: Brier 1950; Lichtenstein, Fischhoff & Phillips 1982; Roediger & Karpicke 2006
mechanics.metric: exam_finish score inside the 80% range shown before it, ~80% of the time (users with >= 2 mocks)

mechanics.name: The commonplace book
mechanics.from: Erasmus, De copia (1512); Locke, A New Method of Making Common-Place-Books (1706)
mechanics.metric: key_action {action: 'commonplace_add'}: share of users with >= 5 entries and their 7-day return vs none

mechanics.name: Question first
mechanics.metric: key_action {action: 'recall_first'}; first-try accuracy on later reviews, recall-first vs normal

decisions.question: The cited answer: keep, change or revert?
decisions.why: Its metric only went live today (#10); judge it on source_open data, not on taste.

decisions.question: Likely score on a fresh paper: keep, change or revert?
decisions.why: Needs users with two or more mocks before calibration can be judged.

decisions.question: The commonplace book: keep, change or revert?
decisions.why: commonplace_add has been tracked since #4; no change made this round.

decisions.question: Question first: which form, if any?
options: A: tap to reveal the options
B: type your answer in a few words first
C: options fade in after a few seconds
decisions.why: Signature move, waits for Pavol. A keeps the retrieval step for one tap and compares cleanly. Mockups: docs/signature/question-first-{a,b,c}.png.

decisions.question: Abstract reasoning: should the dot count wrap (6 -> 1) mid-series?
options: wrap and say so in the instructions
decisions.why: A wrap reads as a trick, not as reasoning.

decisions.question: Abstract reasoning: how should distractors be built?
options: balanced design: 2x2 grid for two rules, pairs differing in two rules for three
decisions.why: The review showed 'pick the option most like the others' scored 98% on the draft; the balanced design gives no shortcut (tested over 2,000 seeds).

decisions.question: Abstract reasoning on a phone: how to show six figures at 390 px?
decisions.why: One row at 390 px makes dots too small to count; this uses the existing card grid, so it is not a new presentation.

decisions.question: Analytics guard on fork and Dependabot PRs?
decisions.default_taken: skip on fork/Dependabot PRs, run on main and same-repo PRs
decisions.why: Same-repo PRs catch a missing secret before merge.

decisions.question: Vendored BOT_UA false positives ('bot\b' matches a CUBOT phone UA; 'preview' is broad)?
decisions.why: A fleet-wide rule belongs in the flywheel kit; flagged for flywheel.

next: Pavol: keep/change/revert on the three live moves; pick question-first A/B/C or none.
Flywheel kit: take the check-analytics fix (match https://<ref>.supabase.co) and review BOT_UA false positives.
Read source_open per answered verified question after a week of traffic; it is the cited answer's metric.
Verbal reasoning (CS/SK/EN) is the last reasoning test not covered; exam coverage, not a signature move.
Combined reasoning score: show numerical + abstract against 10/20 when both are sat in a session.
